criteria.detail: The draft planner includes source attribution and a path summary only. Operational offline lifecycle, approval, audit integrity and sync remain unspecified and unverified.

criteria.detail: Device and operational offline test conditions are unknown. Desktop and narrow browser contexts are not representative-device evidence.

criteria.detail: External judging is unavailable. Preserve the packet rubric verbatim in documentation; do not calculate or self-award a score.

criteria.requirement: A fieldable package for at least one Sailor-built tool
criteria.detail: Only a synthetic draft record is feasible without the owner application, target platform, authorization evidence and external owners. Packaging alone grants no authorization.

criteria.requirement: A reusable fielding playbook for the next one
